_what: The Connections screen's 'What integration should come next?' list: the services this person asked for, kept as one account fact. `fact` is where the list is kept, `max` how many it holds, `name_max` and `note_max` how long a name and a note may be. `report_kind` is the kind (records/hq-reports.json) of the report that also tells the people who make Trillion. `learn_more` is the words of a service card's Learn more panel. `plan_gate` is the words of a service card the person's plan does not let them connect (the plan owner, src/plan-comparison.mjs, decides which). Every word shown is here.
